WITH enriched AS (
  SELECT
    w.id,
    w.received_at,
    w.method,
    w.path,
    w.status,
    w.active,
    w.substatus,
    w.ttl_expires_at,
    w.query_params,
    w.headers,
    w.body_text,
    w.body_base64,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.tenant, ''), 'unknown') AS tenant,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.app, ''), 'unknown') AS app,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.event, ''), 'unknown') AS event
  FROM incoming_webhooks w
  WHERE $__timeFilter(w.received_at)
), selected_webhook AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM enriched
  WHERE ('${tenant}' = '__all' OR tenant = '${tenant}')
    AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR app = '${app}')
    AND ('${event}' = '__all' OR event = '${event}')
    AND ('${payload_search}' = '' OR path ILIKE '%' || '${payload_search}' || '%' OR COALESCE(body_text, '') ILIKE '%' || '${payload_search}' || '%')
    AND ('${webhook_id}' = '' OR id::text = ${webhook_id:singlequote})
  ORDER BY received_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT id, received_at, method, path, tenant, app, event, status, active, substatus, ttl_expires_at, body_text IS NOT NULL AS utf8_payload, octet_length(decode(body_base64, 'base64')) AS payload_bytes
FROM selected_webhook;

FROM selected_webhook sw, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sw.query_params) AS kv(key, value)
ORDER BY kv.key;

FROM selected_webhook sw,

  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant, ''), 'unknown') AS tenant
  FROM incoming_webhooks
  WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
)

FROM enriched
WHERE tenant IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1;

WITH enriched AS (
  SELECT
    w.id,
    w.received_at,
    w.path,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.tenant, ''), 'unknown') AS tenant,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.app, ''), 'unknown') AS app,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(w.event, ''), 'unknown') AS event,
    left(COALESCE(w.body_text, '[binary payload]'), 80) AS payload_preview
  FROM incoming_webhooks w
  WHERE $__timeFilter(w.received_at)
)
SELECT CONCAT(to_char(received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZ'), ' | ', tenant, ' | ', app, ' | ', event, ' | ', left(path, 60)) AS __text, id::text AS __value
FROM enriched
WHERE ('${tenant}' = '__all' OR tenant = '${tenant}')
  AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR app = '${app}')
  AND ('${event}' = '__all' OR event = '${event}')
  AND ('${payload_search}' = '' OR path ILIKE '%' || '${payload_search}' || '%' OR COALESCE(payload_preview, '') ILIKE '%' || '${payload_search}' || '%')
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
